answer: Each identity locks a 70-credit bond and files a quill-signed trade log: eight counterparties per epoch, none over a quarter. Every trade on tundra routes emits a signal serial; auditors check it, and a reused serial, short set, or dominant partner burns the bond. Fees run 36 first, 36+7(k-1) after, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,532,500 plus 70,000 locked; a rented-counterparty ring fails, as each fake needs its own partners. Honest agents pay 36 once.
